negative_control.injected: silicon density x 1.038 on the Geant4 side (reference keeps 2.329 g/cm3)

reference.source: Bethe mean rate, PDG RPP 2024, Passage of particles through matter (pdg.lbl.gov/2024/reviews/rpp2024-rev-passage-particles-matter.pdf), eq. 34.5, with I, Z/A, density and Sternheimer parameters from the study spec (PDG Atomic and Nuclear Properties, silicon, 2024 edition: density 2.329 g/cm3, A 28.0855(3) g/mol (Z/A = 14/28.0855), I 173.0 eV, Sternheimer coefficients a, k, x0, x1, Cbar, delta0 from the header of MUE/muE_silicon_Si.txt (refdata/pdg-silicon-2024.json); never from the Geant4 material dump)
reference.validity: 0.1 <~ beta gamma <~ 1000, accuracy a few percent

scope.observable: mean energy loss of transmitted primaries / thickness (MeV/cm); deposit is not energy loss
